name: agent-messages
description: Panel items after a line number (at most limit) plus {unknown, last_line, session_id}; `session` reads an earlier one.
why: The old Phoenix agent's panel.

name: agent-new
description: Ask the agent to save its notes, wait for it to settle, then restart it into a fresh conversation.
why: The old agent's panel.

name: agent-restart
description: Restart the agent's systemd service (the `agent.unit` setting) and tell Alex; {restarted, unit}.
why: The old agent's panel.

name: agent-send
description: Post a message to the agent and record who sent it; OpsError with the reason on failure.
why: The old Phoenix agent's panel.

name: agent-sessions
description: Earlier conversations in the agent folder's transcript directory, newest first.
why: The old Phoenix agent's panel.

name: agent-status
description: The agent's {state, pid, session_id, name}.
why: The old Phoenix agent's panel; not for the new agent.

name: agent-stop
description: End the command the agent is running and tell it to stop; {stopped, sent}. Refuses when it is not running.
why: The old agent's panel.

name: blocks-check
description: Check a {kind, json} block; return {ok, reason, resolved} (resolved is None when not ok).
why: A dashboard editor helper; not a control.

name: build-discard
description: Throw away a failed or stopped run's work: its worktree, local branch and GitHub branch (if pushed).
why: Planned for a later agent build; for now Alex uses the dashboard.

name: build-note
description: Append a dated note under `## Fix notes` in a task's task.md; the next attempt's prompt carries it.
why: Planned for a later agent build; for now Alex uses the dashboard.

name: build-pause
description: Pause now: stop the running AI step's container (stop, not remove) and leave the run's worktree alone.

name: build-plan
description: The step plan for the project's settings plus these overrides (a wrong override is reported in `errors`).

inputs.name: overrides
inputs.description: Optional settings to try for this build.

name: build-resume
description: Resume a paused run: `running` (the runner picks it up), or `queued` when another run is going.

name: build-start
description: Start a run from a spec in the project's notes, or from a short brief (needs the Planner on).

inputs.name: spec
inputs.description: The spec to build (the newest one if left out).

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: A short brief to build from instead of a spec.

inputs.name: overrides
inputs.description: Settings to use for this build only.

name: build-stop
description: Stop a run the one clean way (`project`, when given, must own the run).

name: builds-list
description: List a project's recent builds, newest first, each with status, finish time and the failed task's one-line reason.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: How many builds at most (10 if left out).

name: cards-build
